description: Per-app, per-data-type permission grants for your health data — with a full access log.
notes: Toggle matrix writes to access log; pending requests approve/deny
shared/kit.js + kit.css empty at build time; full Kit fallback inlined

notes.note: 'OAuth for health data' is the classic platform fantasy: you don't own the data sources, you have no distribution, and Apple Health already does half of it with the phone in everyone's pocket. Platforms are built from distribution, not declared. Kill the platform framing; the consent-logging piece might survive as a feature.
Grant toggles per data-type per app; access log + pending requests tabs OK, zero errors.

notes.change: Time-boxed grant approvals (7/30 days/forever) with auto-expiry and expiry badges; requests persist once handled; fixed silently-broken Revoke-all modal (real kit uses fn, not onClick).
